basics.name: Saurabh Nigam
basics.label: Engineering Manager, Data & ML Platforms
basics.summary: Engineering Manager since 2024, with 10+ years in engineering across distributed systems and data platforms, 5 of them in technical leadership. Led Team Pontus, an 18-person organisation run through 2 team leads, setting its engineering process and owning architecture for bank-grade data platforms serving 5 to 6 enterprise banking customers. Rated Outstanding in two consecutive cycles (2024-25 and 2025-26). Now leads Zeta's Metis change data capture (CDC) replication and Elara ML infrastructure teams, drives architecture for an in-house lakehouse and builds AI agents and agent harnesses hands-on.

work.name: Zeta
work.summary: Scope moved in 2026 from credit and loans data platforms (Team Pontus) to data replication and ML infrastructure platforms (Metis, Elara). Hands-on in design, architecture and code review (Java, Python).
highlights: [Metis and Elara platforms, 2026 to present] Leads two infrastructure platform teams: Metis for streaming change data capture (CDC) replication on Debezium, Kafka and Kubernetes operators; Elara for a Jupyter notebook platform and full-stack ML inference apps.

[Metis and Elara platforms, 2026 to present] Drives the architecture for an in-house lakehouse and transformation platform, with Spark and Redshift as interchangeable execution engines behind one interface.
[Metis and Elara platforms, 2026 to present] Defines CI/CD as a first-class product for internal teams, kept deliberately separate from application CI/CD.
[Metis and Elara platforms, 2026 to present] Owns roadmaps, SLAs and 24x7 reliability for both platforms with Product, SRE and Release Engineering.
[Metis and Elara platforms, 2026 to present] Heads end-to-end far-site disaster recovery for the Metis replication platform, which feeds downstream data and ML systems.

[Team Pontus, Jan 2024 to 2026] Led an 18-person backend, platform and BI engineering org through 2 team leads, owning hiring, calibration and performance management, with 0% attrition and zero major production incidents in H1 2026.

[Team Pontus, Jan 2024 to 2026] Set the engineering process across teams, from quarterly capacity planning and CI coverage gates to enforced data contracts that reduced schema breaks across hundreds of downstream services.

[Team Pontus, Jan 2024 to 2026] Conceived and architected a declarative Kubernetes operator, built by the team, that replaced per-team operators, cut tenant onboarding from weeks to minutes and was adopted by 6 internal product lines.
[Team Pontus, Jan 2024 to 2026] Directed the team that cut the largest aggregate models from 15+ to under 2 minutes and a large private bank's end-of-day batch from ~1.5 hours to ~35 minutes.

[Team Pontus, Jan 2024 to 2026] Wrote the Redshift Serverless risk analysis that paused a premature migration, then guided a tenant-isolated rollout; the team halved base capacity from 128 to 64 RPUs, cutting infrastructure cost.
[AI-native engineering, 2024 to present] Built and open-sourced dbt-coverage with AI coding: a dbt and SQL test-coverage tool adopted at Zeta as a CI/CD quality gate.

[AI-native engineering, 2024 to present] Launched a prompt-to-PR dbt harness for analytics engineers that turns a requirement into a tested, documented, quality-gated pull request, with an eval loop scoring agent skills against task suites.

[AI-native engineering, 2024 to present] Built an AI lineage and incident-triage agent (LangChain, Claude) that uses dbt manifests to isolate root causes of pipeline failures, with ~80% accuracy on evals.

[AI-native engineering, 2024 to present] Created a demand-deposit datamart for a new strategic client in one week with AI-assisted development, then anchored it technically until the client's dedicated team was hired.

work.name: Zeta
highlights: Led and mentored a 5-engineer team that delivered a fault-tolerant loan servicing platform for HDFC Bank, one of India's largest private banks.
Architected a high-throughput, event-driven financial transaction system on Kafka, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Redis.
Improved SQL performance by ~50% through indexing, query refactoring and data modelling.
Partnered with Product, SRE and Release Engineering on testing, monitoring and release processes for regulated banking systems.

work.name: FarEye
highlights: Designed and built core Java microservices for real-time, global-scale logistics and delivery operations.
Led the migration to Kubernetes, enabling containerised deployments and faster release velocity.
Built a real-time Spark and Kafka data pipeline that improved system throughput by ~60%.
Introduced a platform-wide alerting and notification system that improved observability and incident response.
